$comment: Mission 1.64 Part C. Readiness recomputed, the outcome, and the handoff. No pair gate was evaluated.
mission: 1.64 — Anchor Enquiry Dispatch & ONYPHE Residual Closure V1
primary_outcome_statement: The approved enquiry is hash-verified under three hashing boundaries, still current on all seven questions, and unsent, because the one input it needs is an exact first-party address that only a person viewing the published legal page can read. The three candidate documentation targets were completed as the brief permits: two slots are better evidenced, no slot changed, and the candidate remains individually unresolved. Zero apparatuses qualify.

why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_A_B_or_C: All three require the enquiry to have been sent. It was not, and no dispatch was attempted.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_D: MANUAL_ANCHOR_ENQUIRY_DISPATCH_REQUIRED is defined for the case where the exact contact channel IS established and no authorised mail sender exists. The channel is not established, so the missing piece is upstream of the mechanism. A dispatch packet is still produced, with the recipient left blank, because it is useful the moment the address arrives.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_F: ONYPHE_TEMPORAL_OBJECT_NOT_ADDRESSABLE requires datascan to be ESTABLISHED as maintained last-seen state. It is ambiguous, and four documented statements lean the other way. Recording the unfavourable reading as established would be the same error as recording the favourable one.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_G: ONYPHE_DATASCAN_CONFIGURATION_GAP requires the port configuration to be unestablishABLE. It is unpublished, which one question closes.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_H: ONYPHE_LOCATION_FIELDS_RETENTION_GAP requires the locating fields not to survive the necessary retrieval contract. Under the conservative thirty-day contract they survive by the provider's own description; the unknown constrains whether a longer window is available.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_I: No target measurement, count, host record or banner was retrieved.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_E_fits: Section 45 defines E for the operator not having supplied an exact first-party displayed contact address, and states that the ONYPHE reads may still complete. Both halves describe this mission exactly.

readiness.sending_the_enquiry_would_not_have_chang: An anchor gate moves on a received and reviewed answer, never on a dispatch. Even a sent enquiry leaves the count at zero until a reply is read.
readiness.if_the_candidate_had_qualified: The count would have been one, and pairing would still be unavailable. A qualified apparatus is not paired with an unresolved one.

the_negative_controls_were_left_alone.why: Their failures are properties of what those platforms publish, and neither is closed by further reading.

the_shape_this_mission_leaves.$comment: Worth stating, because two apparatuses blocked on unpublished facts is one problem rather than two.
the_shape_this_mission_leaves.observation: Both remaining apparatuses are now blocked on documentation that exists inside the provider and not outside it. The anchor has six such questions and the candidate has three, and every one of the nine is a methodology question that asks for no data.
the_shape_this_mission_leaves.consequence: The instrument for both is the same: a written enquiry to a first-party channel. The anchor's is drafted, approved and waiting on an address. The candidate's is not drafted.
the_shape_this_mission_leaves.what_this_is_not: It is not a finding that either apparatus is unsuitable. Nine unpublished operational facts is a documentation posture, not an apparatus defect.

next_mission_recommendation.the_single_blocking_input: the exact first-party contact address displayed on the anchor's published legal page
next_mission_recommendation.how_the_operator_supplies_it: open https://netlas.io/legal/ in a browser, where the obfuscated address renders, and give the exact displayed string
next_mission_recommendation.and_one_decision_beside_it: whether a second enquiry should be drafted to the candidate carrying its three residual questions, on the same frozen-and-approved pattern
it_should: dispatch the approved anchor enquiry once an exact address exists, through a channel the operator authorises, exactly once
record any reply as OPERATOR_CORRESPONDENCE evidence and review it in a separate step before any gate moves
draft a candidate enquiry carrying the three residual questions, frozen and hashed, if the operator wants that route opened
it_must_not: send anything to a guessed or inferred address
send from the operator's account without the operator asking for it
treat a dispatch as an answer, or an answer as a PASS before review
resolve the candidate's record-lifecycle ambiguity by querying records
transfer a configuration fact from one data category to another
select or rank a pair before two apparatuses individually qualify
